defects.what: Two pictures stacked: a strip of a night beach with outrigger boats across the top quarter, cut by a hard edge above the close-up of the fisherman in the straw hat.
Two white comic speech bubbles with squiggle glyphs float above the girl standing in the lower boat.
A small red seal-like stamp with glyphs sits on a worker's hand at the bottom centre.
A framed picture on the back wall inside the doorway carries pseudo-glyphs.
The sepia print has a thin drawn border line around the whole picture, like a framed engraving.
The paper on the table carries faint scribbled lines of pseudo-text under the writer's hand.
defects.left: one try for a minor: the redraw is a better picture, but faint ruled lines remain on the paper under the hands
